core: Dietary lipid absorption and lipoprotein turnover
qualifier: vitamin E and plant sterol absorption
name: Dietary lipid, vitamin E, sterol absorption and lipoprotein turnover
rationale: All members concern intestinal lipid absorption and chylomicron/VLDL/LDL/HDL assembly, remodeling and clearance; unlike the confusables it adds vitamin E transport/metabolism and ABCG5/ABCG8 sitosterolemia (sterol efflux).

core: E2F target transcription and pre-replicative complex activation
name: E2F target transcription and pre-replicative complex activation
rationale: Members are E2F/G1-S transcription programmes and replication-initiation steps (ORC/CDC6 loading, pre-RC activation, Orc1 removal, replication checkpoint); it is the narrow core lacking the broader cell-cycle, ORC assembly, unwinding and G2/M terms of its superset.

core: E2F-driven cell cycle progression and replication origin licensing
name: E2F-driven cell cycle progression with ORC assembly, origin unwinding
rationale: All members are E2F-regulated proliferation and DNA replication initiation; beyond the narrower confusable it includes ORC assembly, DNA unwinding, E2F6 regulation, generic cell cycle modules and G1/S plus G2/M transition.

qualifier: endothelial turnover and vascular wound healing
name: Endothelial cell activation, turnover and vascular wound healing
rationale: All members regulate endothelial activation, leukocyte-endothelial adhesion, endothelial proliferation/apoptosis, vessel remodeling and vascular wound healing, without the macrophage, synoviocyte and MMP terms of the superset or the smooth-muscle terms of other confusables.

name: Vascular endothelial activation with macrophage survival, synoviocyte proliferation
rationale: Shares the endothelial activation, leukocyte adhesion and vessel remodeling core, and is distinguished by an inflammatory-tissue context: macrophage apoptosis inhibition, synoviocyte proliferation, MMP secretion and extracellular region genes.

name: Epidermal cornification, skin appendage and odontogenic development
rationale: Members cover keratinocyte differentiation, cornified envelope and skin barrier, hair follicle, nail, sebaceous and mammary placodes plus odontoblast/cementum tooth development; it lacks the EDA-ID NF-kB and junction terms of its superset and the melanocyte/MITF terms of others.

name: Ectodermal dysplasia-linked epidermal, hair and tooth development
rationale: All members concern skin, hair, nail, gland and tooth ectodermal development; beyond the confusables it includes IKBKG/IkBA anhidrotic ectodermal dysplasia, dentinogenesis, tooth eruption and epithelial junction modules.

qualifier: lung bud and salivary branching, mesenchymal proliferation
name: Lung and salivary bud branching with mesenchymal proliferation control
rationale: All members concern reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signaling and mesenchymal/epithelial proliferation driving lung bud and salivary branching (plus limb bud); it lacks the trachea and lung vasculature terms of its superset.

name: Lung and salivary branching with trachea, lung vasculature formation
rationale: Shares the lung/salivary epithelial-mesenchymal branching core and adds trachea formation and cartilage, lung vasculature development and terminal-unit dichotomous branching.

name: ERBB2 kinase-domain mutant resistance to afatinib, neratinib, tesevatinib
rationale: All three members are ERBB2 KD mutant resistance to a specific inhibitor; the drug set (afatinib, neratinib, tesevatinib) separates it from the broader six-drug theme.

name: ERBB2 kinase-domain mutant resistance including osimertinib, sapitinib, AEE788
rationale: All members are ERBB2 KD mutant resistance to tyrosine kinase inhibitors; unlike the three-drug confusable it also covers osimertinib, sapitinib and AEE788.

name: Estrogen-dependent gene expression and progesterone receptor signaling
rationale: Members are estrogen/estradiol responses, ER signaling and PR signaling; unlike the three-member subset it includes estrogen-dependent transcription, estradiol response and AP-2 growth-factor regulation, and lacks the androgen terms of other confusables.

name: Cellular estrogen response and progesterone receptor signaling
rationale: Its three members are cellular estrogen response, positive regulation of intracellular ER signaling and PR signaling; it is the minimal receptor-level core without the estrogen-dependent gene expression of its superset or the androgen/mammary terms of others.

name: G-CSF signaling and myeloid progenitor commitment to neutrophils
rationale: All members concern G-CSF signaling, granulocyte/neutrophil differentiation and myeloid progenitor commitment; it lacks the RUNX1 and transcriptional granulopoiesis terms of its superset and the eosinophil/mast cell terms of others.

name: Transcriptional control of granulopoiesis with G-CSF signaling
rationale: Shares the G-CSF neutrophil differentiation core and adds RUNX1 regulation of HSC differentiation, transcriptional regulation of granulopoiesis and general leukocyte differentiation.

name: Glycerol and fructose metabolism feeding triacylglycerol synthesis
rationale: Members cover glycerol/glycerol-3-phosphate and fructose/alditol metabolism, aquaporin glycerol and urea transport and PA/DAG/TAG synthesis; it lacks the lysophospholipid hydrolysis of its superset and the lipolysis terms of others.

name: Glycerol, acylglycerol synthesis and lysophospholipid hydrolysis
rationale: Shares glycerol/G3P, fructose, aquaporin transport and acylglycerol synthesis, and is distinguished by glycerophospholipid catabolism via LPC and LPE hydrolysis.

qualifier: GH, prolactin, leptin and thyroid hormone
name: Endocrine body-growth control by GH, prolactin, leptin, thyroid hormone
rationale: All members are GH, prolactin, leptin and thyroid hormone signaling or generation and organismal growth regulation; it lacks the amino acid transport and lifespan terms of its superset and the steroidogenic or IL-6-type terms of others.

qualifier: lifespan and neutral amino acid transport
name: Growth and lifespan hormonal control with neutral amino acid transport
rationale: Shares the GH/prolactin/leptin/thyroid growth-hormone core and adds growth rate, adult lifespan, GH secretion and large neutral amino acid (leucine, isoleucine, phenylalanine) transport.

core: Hindbrain and spinal cord neuron specification
qualifier: brainstem maturation, motor and interneuron fate
name: Brainstem maturation and spinal motor and interneuron specification
rationale: Members cover dorsoventral neural tube patterning, spinal motor and interneuron fate, and hindbrain/pons maturation and migration; it lacks the cranial nerve, DRG and peripheral neuron terms of its superset.

core: Hindbrain and spinal cord neuron patterning
qualifier: cranial nerve and sensory ganglion development
name: Hindbrain-spinal neuron patterning with cranial nerve and sensory ganglion development
rationale: Shares the hindbrain/spinal patterning core and adds trigeminal and facial nerve, branchiomotor axon guidance, dorsal root ganglion and peripheral neuron differentiation and suckling behavior.

core: HSF1 heat shock response and stress granules
name: Heat and arsenite stress responses via HSF1, stress granules
rationale: Members are HSF1 activation/attenuation, heat acclimation, stress granule assembly/disassembly, PML bodies, PKR signaling and arsenite response; it lacks the protein refolding and mitochondrial UPR terms of its superset.

core: HSF1 heat shock response and stress granules
name: Proteotoxic stress: HSF1, stress granules, refolding, mitochondrial UPR
rationale: Shares the HSF1/stress granule core and adds protein refolding, ER protein folding, inclusion body regulation, ATP-dependent chaperone activity and mitochondrial unfolded protein response.

qualifier: IL-6, LIF, CNTF receptors via STAT3 and ERK1/2
name: IL-6, LIF and CNTF receptor signaling via STAT3, ERK1/2
rationale: All members concern IL-6-type (IL-6, LIF, CNTF) receptor signaling activating STAT3 and ERK1/2; it lacks the IL-11, autocrine/paracrine and inflammatory cytokine-output terms of its superset.

name: Autocrine and paracrine IL-6-family, IL-11 inflammatory cytokine signaling
rationale: Shares IL-6/LIF/CNTF STAT3-ERK signaling and adds IL-11 signaling, autocrine and paracrine signaling, inflammatory cytokine modules and negative regulation of STAT phosphorylation.
